title: Act: Add background layer and chair/wardrobe SVGs with manifest entries
summary: Create six SVGs and register them
description: Create wall, floor, window-view, lighting, chair and wardrobe pixel-art SVGs and add six entries to manifest.json.
acceptance_criteria: Six files exist at the paths in the manifest
Six manifest entries carry matching dimensions

steps.action: Create a 320x120 SVG with shape-rendering="crispEdges": a warm beige wall rect, a darker wainscot strip and a few baseboard rects. Same for floor.svg (320x60 wood planks in two browns), window-view.svg (60x50 night sky blue with stars and moon), lighting.svg (320x180 translucent warm-yellow rect and darker corner rects using fill-opacity), chair.svg (24x32 brown chair) and wardrobe.svg (48x90 dark wood with two doors and handles).
steps.code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="320" height="120" shape-rendering="crispEdges"><rect width="320" height="120" fill="#d8c4a0"/><rect y="96" width="320" height="24" fill="#b89c70"/></svg>
steps.expected: Six SVG files exist, each with width/height equal to its stated size

steps.action: Append six entries: background:wall (320x120), background:floor (320x60), background:window-view (60x50), background:lighting (320x180), furniture:chair (24x32, interactionBounds 0,0,24,32), furniture:wardrobe (48x90, interactionBounds 0,0,48,90), each type image with path relative to worlds/the-boys-room.
steps.expected: Manifest parses with six more unique ids
